Name: Global Settings
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b]Global Settings[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]A searchable global settings menu to sync settings across all saves, with some other QoL tweaks of my own.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55454/55454-1794604051-1825828591.png[/img][/center]
[line]
[center][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=6]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]Open the menu from the custom [color=#93c47d][size=3]top-left title icon[/size][/color] or a configurable hotkey set from Tweaks tab.[/*]
[*]General, Sound, Graphics, Controls, and additional Tweaks tab.[/*]
[*]Search bar to filter through all tabs at once.[/*]
[*][color=#b6d7a8]Save[/color] applies immediately. [color=#ea9999]Reset[/color] restores the current tab. [color=#dd7e6b]Reset All[/color] restores everything.[/*]
[*]Audio is applied everywhere, including menus before a save is loaded.[/*]
[*]Excluded saves keep their own settings untouched.[/*]
[*]Rows follow vanilla visibility rules and dim when unavailable.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Per-Save Exclusion[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Every valid save is listed in the [color=#f9cb9c]Tweaks [/color]tab with a toggle.[/*]
[*]Excluded saves load with their own options instead of your global settings.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Keybinds[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Rebind every vanilla control from the Controls tab.[/*]
[*]Combinations are supported, such as Ctrl + key.[/*]
[*]Live conflict warnings for exact and partial overlaps.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Client-side only and safe to use in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Server mode, IP connections, and farmhand creation, move-building permissions and end-of-night ready status only available if multiplayer game detected.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Tweaks[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]Experimental and personal settings behind a one-time warning which include:[/size]
[list]
[*]   Replace the title-screen mute icon with a settings button. [/*]
[*]   Skip the intro animation to the title buttons.[/*]
[*]   Preload the Load and Host save lists on the title screen.[/*]
[*]   Keep the game running while the window is unfocused.[/*]
[*]   Mute music outside saves. (on menus)[/*]
[*]   Remove text shadows.[/*]
[*]   Disable menu animations if you prefer instant transitions.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Coverage[/b][/size]
[spoiler][size=4]Covers these Options page groups:[/size]
[list]
[*][b]General[/b] - auto run, portraits, tool hit location, gamepad mode, item stowing, slingshot fire mode, snappy menus, advanced crafting info, dialogue typing, animal sounds, bite chime.[/*]
[*][b]Sound[/b] - music, sound, ambient, footstep, and dialogue volume.[/*]
[*][b]Graphics[/b] - window mode, resolution, VSync, menu background, UI scale, zoom, zoom buttons, toolbar lock, snow transparency, flash effects, hardware cursor, controller rumble, invert toolbar scroll.[/*]
[*][b]Controls[/b] - action, use tool, menu, journal, map, movement, chat, emote, run, toolbar swap, and inventory slot keys.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b] - server mode, IP connections, farmhand creation, building permissions, ready status.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[color=#93c47d]No known conflicts.[/color]
[line]
[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[/list]No other dependencies. The settings menu is built in; Generic Mod Config Menu is not used.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Open the menu from the title icon or your hotkey.[/*]
[/list][line]
